title: Pull the claim
line: A man is tied to a pickup by his socks, and the truck drives off.
proof: Sold: $1.5m to $3m in a year, 65% from one ad

title: Show the strange tool
line: A hat maker lowers a measuring machine of rods on a customer's head, without a word
proof: Seen 96.3 million times, 60.2 times its usual

title: The maker wears it
line: A stranger asks an old man in a fish cap: where did you get that?
proof: Sold: first run of 2,500 hats, the maker says

title: One reason, one movement
line: An unknown founder folds a clear bag into a normal one
proof: Seen 11.9 million times, 9444.4 times its usual

title: Pack one real order
line: A small jewellery shop opens drawer after drawer for one customer's parcel
proof: Seen 3.7 million times, 399.6 times its usual
